ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Advanced Topics in Sexual Harassment. Graduate Students should sign up for this section. This seminar examines research and scholarship on the behavioral, organizational, and legal aspects of sexual harassment in work and educational organizations. We will focus on the classic texts (e.g., MacKinnon's "Sexual Harrassment of Working Women") as well as important legal decisions (e.g., Harris v. Forklift, Oncale v. Sundowner Oil Company), forensic applications, and current research questions.
